Which Langley areas have a guide?

Eleven, each named for its MLS® sub-area: Brookswood, Aldergrove, Walnut Grove, Willoughby Heights, Murrayville, Langley City, Fort Langley, Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley, Salmon River and Otter District.
Is Langley City part of the Township of Langley?
No. The City of Langley was incorporated as its own municipality on March 15, 1955, next to the Township of Langley.
